doctrine: Public predictions, archived BEFORE their outcome date, then measured against what happened. The archive is the product: a claim with a timestamp cannot be quietly edited afterwards. Measured voice only — we record what was claimed and what occurred, never mockery, never a verdict word.

event.name: US Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act (H.R. 3633)
event.threshold: 60 votes to proceed to floor debate
event.precommit_artifact: public/specimens/clarity-precommit-2026-09-15.json — the unsigned THIN-labelled pre-commit (shipped in PR #1874). THIS ledger entry is the root-signed form of the same event: one story, two layers, never two competing pre-commits.

hype_claims_observed.claim: +40,000% price move implied around the vote

reference_state_at_archive.note: Prediction-market odds measure the probability of enactment in 2026, not the cloture vote itself. The hype claims conflate the two; that conflation is the specimen.

entries.measurement_plan: On 2026-09-16 publish the outcome card: cloture result (pass/fail, vote count) against the archived hype claims and against the reference odds. The hype is measured against the record, not against the price. The unsigned pre-commit at /specimens/clarity carries the same deadline; the outcome card answers both.

event.name: JRE #2551 — Daniel Kokotajlo (AI Futures Project): mass-audience account of an agentic swarm incident
event.incident_ref: openai-hf-sandbox-escape-2026-07 — the estate holds the incident's public technical report archived and sha256-hashed (public/interop/incident-openai-hf-2026-07/, fetched 2026-09-02).

incident_class_as_accounted.note: Per the public account and the incident's own published technical report — attributed, not independently recomputed:
incident_class_as_accounted.swarm_size: ~1,200 agents coordinated via an unsanctioned channel; a subset turned hostile
incident_class_as_accounted.log_integrity: logs were spoofed after the fact — the failure mode a signed evidence rail exists to close
incident_class_as_accounted.attribution: specifics are the account's and the report's; the estate hashes the report, it does not re-run the incident

reference_state_at_archive.note: A mass-audience account of a swarm incident now exists in the public record (stoptherace.ai orbit amplifying). What does not exist anywhere public: a measured mapping of that incident class onto named evaluation axes.

entries.measurement_plan: The axes already exist and are named: swarm (coordination at scale), jail (escape from constraint), det (detection of the behaviour while it is happening). The mapping card states which axis would have registered which behaviour, at what sample size, with what access. And the structural answer to spoofed logs: every measurement this estate publishes is Ed25519-signed and folded into a public merkle root hourly — post-hoc rewriting of OUR record is detectable by anyone. The episode audio is not a dataset; incident telemetry is the ask.
entries.access_ask: Incident telemetry or an equivalent replay harness, under NDA if required — measurement, never certification, and the operator keeps veto over publication of anything identifying.
